scientific_question: Can an exchangeable, learned two-scalar predictive state infer action-dependent hidden dynamics from public observation/action sequences, without receiving latent graph, identity, world state or future outcomes other than ordinary next-observation self-supervision?
why_distinct: Q19B trained on SIX supervised true ancestral-relationship labels. Q20 instead trains using ONLY next public observations, with latent state and causal sensor identity never labeled; candidate learns a two-state symmetry/equivariance constraint and counterfactual-action-conditioned updates.

synthetic_source.public: At each step two anonymous binary sensor observations and chosen binary action that modulates latent transition; the learner predicts both next sensor bits. No latent state, sensor-role or graph identity available in training, development or inference.
synthetic_source.hidden: One latent bit z initially Ber(0.5), with P(z_next flips|a=0)=flip0 and P(flip|a=1)=flip1. One of two sensor slots is causally responsive and emits z XOR Ber(noise); the other is independent Ber(0.5). Responsive slot randomly exchanged per episode, never observed by models.
synthetic_source.action: a_t~Ber(0.5) independent of z, visible, enforced before z_next; this is a public intervention setting a transition regime, not a do(X) on a visible sensor.
synthetic_source.episode: 13 observation pairs and 12 actions; scored on 12 next-step predictions for both bits (24 scored Bernoulli outcomes/episode). No access to later observations when predicting a step.

candidate.form: h_i'=tanh(a*h_i+b*h_other+c*s_i+d*s_other+e*action_sign+f*action_sign*h_i+g), p(next_bit_i)=sigmoid(v*h_i'+r), shared weights across sensor exchange
candidate.objective: FIT-only next observed bit crossentropy; no latent state labels

recurrent.form: two unrestricted tanh recurrent cells (4 recurrent +4 observed +2 action +2 biases), each next-bit readout 1 weight and 1 bias
recurrent.objective: same fully trained FIT-only next observed bit BCE

flat.form: two separately fitted six-feature action-aware logistic models on public current sensor bits, action and sensor/action interaction
flat.objective: same fully trained FIT-only next observed bit BCE

symbolic.form: FIT-trained Laplace-smoothed counts of joint next observation conditioned on public current joint observation and action, 2 actions x 4 observations x 4 outcomes; derive per-bit marginal probabilities

bayes.form: Fully FIT-trained action-conditioned binary hidden Markov filter, joint binary sensor emissions, unsupervised Baum-Welch EM, 3 deterministic restarts, 12 fit epochs, select min DEV Bernoulli prediction loss; latent states and sensor assignment NOT provided.

oracle.form: Privileged synthetic world with latent responsive sensor slot and exact flip/noise parameters; theoretical reference NOT eligible as equally informed empirical control

training.candidate_recurrent_flat: full FIT next-observation BCE, central difference Adam, 14 fixed epochs, 2 deterministic restarts, full FIT batches, final-epoch dev restart selection; never update weights on DEV
training.checkpoint_select: lowest end-of-training DEV BCE across frozen restarts, no hyperparameter modification
training.metric: mean next-sensor Bernoulli negative log loss (nats/bit), matched per-family loss, wrong-probability and hard false positive counts
training.resources: CPU process_time for training and DEV inference, Python tracemalloc training peak, model state scalars, checkpoint byte counts; comparison within one operating system
training.fairness: All fitted models get identical public FIT and DEV action/observations; only oracle gets true underlying noise/transition laws and per-episode sensor slot. HMM has known 2-state generic architecture (prior knowledge explicitly reported), not exact privileged noise parameters.
